title: Continuous profinite equivariance for coefficient modules
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group and $X$ a scheme. Write $X[P]$ for its canonical profinite parameter scheme [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects]. A continuous action is a morphism $a:X[G]\to X$ whose restrictions to all continuous parameter families $g:P\to G$ obey the unit and multiplication laws. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $M$ an internal $\Lambda_X$-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. A continuous linearization is an isomorphism $a^*M\simeq\mathrm{pr}^*M$, with the unit and cocycle equations on every scheme mapping to $X[G]$ and on composable pairs of such maps, using the actual canonical composition comparisons for inverse image. For an equivariant scheme map the linearization restricts using those comparisons. For a module pulled back from a quotient, its deck linearization is the one induced by equality of the two maps to the quotient. The canonical regular and finite-free pullback comparisons give the matrices of an action in a chosen finite basis, evaluated through the actual continuous coefficient realization [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], [lem-sfb-continuous-ring-universe-realization], [lem-sfb-integral-continuous-presentation-matrix].
